snippet.title: Stealth Runner v1.0 for the TI-99/4A home computer
snippet.description:
Stealth Runner is a third-person open-world action game for the TI-99/4A. The game tries to push the envelope of what is achievable on this early home computer.

Features:
* Pre-rendered graphics (using Blender).
* Smooth motion-captured animation (from Mixamo, at 30 fps).
* Game world with a consistent global state
* Pixel-precise omni-directional scrolling.
* Sound and speech.
* Entirely written in TMS-9900 assembly code.

This is version 1.0.

You can find the source code and the compiled binaries on Github (https://github.com/EricLafortune/StealthRunner).
